# The Painted Pose

> A fine art portrait painting studio and paint party events company offering custom portraits, community art programs, and creative experiences for individuals, schools, and corporate teams.

The Painted Pose, founded by artist Bernade Flournoy, combines professional portrait painting with accessible paint party events and art education. The studio emphasizes diversity, inclusion, and mental wellness through creative activities, serving the Indianapolis community and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Fine art portrait painting
- Paint party events
- Art classes and education
- The Paint Party Lady
- Canvas Club membership
- Team building workshops
- School art programs
- Social-emotional learning (SEL)
- Art community
- Creative wellness
- Custom portrait commissions
- Paint party tools and resources
- Art supplies and kits
- Community art activities
- Bernade Flournoy

## Specialized Programs

- [Team Building](https://www.thepaintedpose.com/teambuilding): Corporate team building and employee wellness paint party programs
- [Schools](https://www.thepaintedpose.com/schools): Educational paint party programs for schools emphasizing SEL and wellness
- [The Art Room](https://www.thepaintedpose.com/art-room): Membership program offering painting classes and art community access
